goal: Prevent bugs and precision issues by enforcing strict compile-time type safety for currency amounts
Stop implicit boolean or float conversions, uninitialized values, and invalid arithmetic on amounts
agreement: Mild agreement overall with an answered scope objection awaiting reply
Concept approval citing clean design and added safety benefits (ryanofsky)
Unanswered objection: converting the whole codebase at once is too risky vs an incremental rollout (l0rinc)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it hardens the core amount type against historical bug classes at compile time
It provides safety leverage across consensus and node code, but as an internal refactor is deferrable
